title: upstar
tagline: By holding membership NFTs, you're not just part of an exclusive club, but you're also building an emotional bond with content creators. You can enjoy monthly subscriptions, rewards, and task level-up mechanisms.
description:
Our project protocol is built on EIP 6551, which enables NFT wallet address functionality. This means that NFT holders can operate and own the assets (such as ERC-20, ERC-721, or ERC-1155 tokens) within the wallet address. We have also developed a simple frontend in the browser that allows end-users to easily join and mint membership NFTs. The frontend includes subscription, countdown, and burn functions, and end-users can deposit ERC-20 and ERC-721 tokens into their membership NFTs using their wallet address.

Content creators on the Lens Protocol can use our platform to initiate their own membership system or create a DAP. In addition, membership NFTs can store OAT tokens earned by users for completing tasks. The club can easily calculate each membership's contribution and distribute rewards directly to their NFTs. Best of all, membership NFTs are transferable, and all assets within the wallet will be transferred to the new NFT owner.

Our goal is to increase the retention rate of web 3.0 social and dApp usage by providing a simple and effective membership solution that benefits both content creators and users.
how_its_made:
The whole project is built with Nextjs frontend and hardhat framework. We used Tokenbound Smart contract as a base and added vault and token character. Currently the contracts are deployed on OP testnet, Scroll testnet and Polygon testnet. We also added Lens protocol to add an extra social layer. 
For this project most of the attemps are using new technology, such as ERC6551 and new Lens SDK, many difficulties and barriers. Cuting edge experimental project.
